products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/J/30
products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/J/30 is part of the Alfix 46 range, namely the professional system designed by Profilpas to lay LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm.  Specifically, FIX/J/30 is a profile to join level floors. Like all other solutions in the range,  FIX/J/30 comprises a top profile in anodised aluminium secured with screws in the same colour as the anodised aluminium, on a natural aluminium base.

products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/L/32
products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/L/32 is a profile to join LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of different heights. This element, which is part of the wider Alfix 46 range, is one of the solutions available for laying this kind of floor, for thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Alfix 46 FIX/L/32 comprises a top profile, available in silver anodised aluminium, secured with screws in the same colour as the anodized aluminium, on a natural aluminium base.

products.name: ALFIX 46 FIX/T/19
products.description: Alfix 46 FIX/T/19 edging profile is part of the Alfix 46 range, the professional system designed by Profilpas for the laying of LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm. Like the other two elements in the range – FIX/J/30 and FIX/L/32 - FIX/T/19 also comprises a top profile in anodised aluminium which is secured with screws to a natural aluminium base. The screws are the same colour as the anodised aluminium and integrate seamlessly with the top profile.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/J/44
products.description: The Alfix 616 aluminium range also includes item FIX/J/44, the perfect profile for joints between wood and laminate floors at the same level.  It is used with floating floors of thicknesses between 6 and 16mm, to separate, protect and decorate the floor, accommodating any expansion. It comprises two parts: an anodised aluminium top profile measuring 44mm, and a natural aluminium base. The two parts are attached via a screw system of the same colour as the profile, supplied in the package, to assure they blend and create a uniform final effect.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/L/55
products.description: One of Profilpas’ products for floating wooden and laminate floors at different heights is the Alfix 616 FIX/L/55 system. This item creates an aluminium joint, ideal for floors widths of 6 to 16mm.  FIX/L/55 is 55mm wide and comprises an anodised aluminium top profile and a natural aluminium base. Both are secured with screws which are provided, in the same colour as the top profile.

products.name: ALFIX 616 FIX/T/33
products.description: The Alfix 616 range of professional aluminium systems for wood and laminate floors also includes the FIX/T/33 edge piece. This outside edge allows you to end the floor with a 90-degree angle. It was designed for 6-16mm thick floors and comprises an anodised aluminium  top profile that is 33m wide and a natural aluminium base. It is secured with a screw system: the screws are provided and are the same colour as the anodised aluminium, to blend in perfectly with the top profile.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE
products.description: Cerfix Proangle is the range of 'L' profiles designed by Profilpas to suit a variety of applications: from closing the external corners of ceramic wall coverings to joining floor coverings of the same level, as well as finishing and protecting the edges of steps, platforms and worktops. Cerfix Proangle is available in aluminium, stainless steel, brass and PVC, in several finishes including Trend Color and Mapei Color; the latter is the special range offering the perfect colour match between profile and grout.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE AX - M DESIGN
products.description: Proangle AX M Design is a vertical edging profile available in aluminium and various finishes that elegantly highlights the discontinuity between walls. M Design is the line designed for interior designers looking for minimalist solutions to customise spaces.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE B
products.description: Proangle is the range of 'L' profiles designed by Profilpas to suit a variety of applications: from closing the external corners of ceramic wall coverings to joining floor coverings of the same level, as well as finishing and protecting the edges of steps, platforms and worktops. Proangle is available in aluminium, stainless steel, brass and PVC, in several finishes including Trend Color and  Mapei Color ; the latter is the special range offering the perfect colour match between profile and grout.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE F
products.description: Cerfix Proangle F is a decorative profile used to seal the external corners and edges of tiled coverings. These particular profiles have a distinctive triangular profile and come in anodised aluminium or stainless steel. The version with a narrower base (FMIS/) in stainless steel is recommended to protect and finish internal corners and edges in tiled coverings.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE FLEX
products.description: Proangle is the range of 'L' profiles designed by Profilpas to suit a variety of applications: from closing the external corners of ceramic wall coverings to joining floor coverings of the same level, as well as finishing and protecting the edges of steps, platforms and worktops. Proangle is available in aluminium, stainless steel, brass and PVC, in several finishes including Trend Color and  Mapei Color ; the latter is the special range offering the perfect colour match between profile and grout.

products.name: CERFIX PROANGLE Q
products.description: Cerfix Proangle Q is the range of square-shaped profiles for edging and protecting the external corners of ceramic coverings, avoiding the delicate and unsightly 45° edge between tiles. Available in aluminium, steel, brass and PVC, this range offers a wide choice of finishes to meet any requirement. In addition, the innovative Trend Color finishes are ideal for those who love elegance and are looking for the perfect match to the most trendy ceramics.

products.name: CERFIX PROBORD IL/ - ILE/ - ILES/
products.description: Probord IL/, ILE/ and ILES/ are external corner profiles which stand out for their soft lines and shapes. These products, which are ideal for accident prevention in environments such as hospitals, swimming pools, wellness centres and industrial kitchens, are characterised by rounded corners. In addition, Probord IL features a single-flange fastening system that facilitates the correct alignment of the profile even in the presence of uneven angles and surfaces.

products.name: CERFIX PROBORD ILN
products.description: Probord ILN is a line of profiles designed to protect the external corners of ceramic wall coverings. Available in AISI 304 and 316 stainless steel, these profiles are ideal in spaces where a high degree of hygienic safety is required and also perform an accident prevention function. This combination of features makes Probord INL profiles particularly recommended for environments such as kitchens, food industries, schools and any environment where hygiene is paramount. The AISI 316 steel version is resistant to chlorine and salt and is therefore also suitable for wellness centres, swimming pools and seaside areas.

products.name: CERFIX PROCORNER M
products.description: Cerfix Procorner M is a line of profiles to protect the external corners of wall coverings, to be applied on already installed wall coverings. Available in aluminium, stainless steel and brass, Cerfix Procorner M profiles are available with a square or rounded corner section and are also available in a self-adhesive version for quick and easy DIY installation.

products.name: CERFIX PROCORNER P
products.description: Cerfix Procorner P is a line of profiles designed to protect the outer edges of wall coverings, intended for installation on already installed wall coverings. Available in PVC, Cerfix Procorner P profiles come in both right-angle and rounded profiles and are also available in bright colors to visually highlight the edges of the wall coverings.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER
products.description: Procover are joint cover profiles suitable for creating continuity on commercial or large structures. Available in different materials and models, they are perfect for covering structural expansion or compression movements of two different load-bearing structures and for concealing any cutting and/or laying imperfections in the floor. These items also easily withstand pedestrian and vehicle traffic with tyred wheels.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER FIX
products.description: Procover Fix is part of the Profilpas range of joint cover profiles. These items, made of aluminium, are characterised by a flat shape and are available in two versions: one for joining two coplanar surfaces (GJA/) and one for joining floor and wall covering (GWA/). Procover Fix structural joint covers are the best choice for covering structural expansion or compression movements of two different load-bearing structures and, at the same time, concealing any cutting and/or laying imperfections.

products.name: CERFIX PROCOVER FLEX
products.description: Procover Flex is a structural joint cover profile for coplanar floors. This article, consisting of a natural aluminium support structure and a black EPDM insert, effectively responds to transverse tensile and compressive movements of industrial or large buildings. It is particularly suitable for surfaces that must withstand pedestrian and wheeled traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR
products.description: Prodecor is a range of profiles designed to finish, seal and protect level tiled, marble, granite, wooden and other types of floor. Thanks to its versatility, Prodecor is also perfect as a separation joint, for example, between tiled floors and carpet or wood, as a perimeter profile to contain doormats, and to protect ceramic tiled steps and platforms. The part on view of the profile lends an elegance to the floor but is not invasive, blending seamlessly into the surface.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR DJ
products.description: Prodecor DJ profiles protect and seal level tiled, marble, granite, wooden or other types of floor, and uncouple floors of different materials. The part on view of the profile blends seamlessly into the floor, creating an elegant surface decoration. Prodecor DJ is also suitable as a perimeter profile to contain doormats, platforms and to protect ceramic tiled steps.

products.name: CERFIX PRODECOR DJ FLEX
products.description: Prodecor DJ Flex is a range of bendable profiles made to finish, seal, protect and decorate tiled, marble, granite, wooden or other types of floors with curved edges, of same height. It is also ideal to separate and as a decorative element between two floors made of different materials at the same level (for example, between tiles and wood or carpet) and as a edging profile to contain doormats, protect the edges of platforms and/or tiled steps.

products.name: CERFIX PROINT
products.description: Proint is a line of internal corner profiles available in aluminium, steel and PVC designed for the perimeter connection in the installation between wall and floor or as a perimeter joint. The particular sections of this line in fact facilitate corner expansion between the two surfaces. Installation is very simple and avoids the use of silicone for sealing, an advantage both from an aesthetic and a hygienic point of view: the absence of silicone in fact prevents the proliferation of dirt and bacteria.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NAN
products.description: Projoint NAN is a natural aluminium expansion joint with an interchangeable elastic vinyl resin insert, available in either grey or stone grey. The special structure of the Projoint NAN joint allows it to protect the edge of the tile and at the same time withstand a high volume of traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular. The strength and shock-absorbing capacity make this expansion joint perfect for use in working and industrial environments. The perforated flanges ensure perfect anchoring between the previously split screed, the profile and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NE
products.description: Among the wide and varied range of Profilpas expansion joints is Projoint NE, a coextruded PVC profile available in different colours and heights. Projoint NE, to be installed with adhesive at fractionation joints created in the screed, is suitable for use on large surfaces with high foot traffic and allows for easy and effective absorption of compression and expansion stresses.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NF
products.description: Large surfaces subject to heavy foot traffic often require expansion joints that can absorb physical stresses. Precisely for this reason, Profilpas has created Projoint DIL NF. The product, made of co-extruded PVC, is available in different colours and heights and is perfect for splitting ceramic flooring. This element, ideal for mortar laying, is a guarantee of quality and responds effectively to compression and expansion stresses.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NIL
products.description: Projoint DIL NIL/ is a perimeter expansion joint in stainless steel, with an interchangeable insert in elastic vinyl resin, characterized by a visible section of 14 mm. The structure of the joint allows to connect the floor to the wall and is able to withstand heavy traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular (forklifts, transpallets and cars).

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NIN
products.description: Projoint NIN is a stainless steel expansion joint with an interchangeable elastic vinyl resin insert. The special structure of the joint provides optimal protection of the tile edge and thus withstands all types of traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular (forklifts, pallet trucks and cars), making it particularly suitable for industrial and commercial environments. The perforated flanges ensure perfect anchoring between the previously split screed, the profile and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NJ
products.description: Projoint DIL NJ is a co-extruded PVC expansion joint with perforated side flanges for perfect anchorage between the (previously split) screed, the profile and the tiles. This profile adapts perfectly to adhesive-laid floors and, thanks to the elasticity of the central part, is able to absorb compression and expansion stress with ease. The PVC used is non-toxic and shockproof, is UV-resistant and can be used indoors and outdoors.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NL
products.description: Projoint DIL NL is a co-extruded PVC expansion joint. The product - made of non-toxic, shockproof and UV-resistant material - features perforated side flanges for perfect anchorage between the (previously split) screed, profile and tiles. NL is ideal for adhesive-laid floors or marble between 8 and 20 millimetres thick and, thanks to its elastic central part, is able to absorb compression and expansion stresses. This characteristic makes the profile particularly suitable for surfaces with light pedestrian or vehicle traffic (cars and pallet trucks) indoors or outdoors.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NPAN
products.description: Projoint NPAN is a natural aluminium expansion joint with an interchangeable elastic vinyl resin insert with a 21 millimetre wide section. The structure of the Projoint NPAN joint allows it to protect the edge of the tile and withstand compression and expansion generated by heavy pedestrian and vehicle traffic. The perforated flange ensure perfect anchoring between the previously split screed, the profile and the tiles.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTA
products.description: Projoint DIL NTA is an adhesive-applied expansion joint with a vulcanised EPDM inner section available in various colours. The natural aluminium structure easily withstands frequent pedestrian and vehicular traffic (forklifts, pallet trucks and cars), and the perforated anchoring flanges guarantee a perfect grip between the (previously split) screed, profile and tiles. The joint has a compression and expansion capability with a range of +2 to -2 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTI
products.description: Projoint DIL NTI is an expansion joint for adhesive-laying with a stainless steel structure and vulcanised EPDM inner section, which can effectively withstand frequent pedestrian and vehicular traffic (forklift trucks, pallet trucks and cars). The perforated flanges guarantee efficient anchoring between the (previously split) screed, the profile and the tiles. The joint has a compression and expansion capability with a range of +2 to -2 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NTO
products.description: Projoint DIL NTO is an expansion joint for adhesive-laying with a natural brass structure and vulcanised EPDM inner section, which effectively withstands frequent pedestrian and vehicular traffic (forklift trucks, pallet trucks and cars). Perforated flanges ensure efficient anchoring between the (previously split) screed, the profile and the tiles. The joint has a compression and expansion capability with a range of +2 to -2 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZA
products.description: Projoint DIL NZA is a natural aluminium expansion joint consisting of two interlocking and sliding profiles. Suitable for ceramic floor coverings, this profile is the ideal solution for surfaces subject to heavy traffic with a contraction and expansion compensation up to 2 mm. NZA is caharacterised by its high resistance to loads and traffic, both pedestrian and vehicular (forklifts, pallet trucks and cars). Perforated anchorage flanges guarantee a perfect grip.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZS
products.description: Projoint Dil NZS is a highly absorbent technical aluminium expansion joint. Thanks to its two telescopically joined parts, this joint can absorb movements up to 5 millimetres, with special articulated fins allowing three-dimensional movements. The design of the joint protects the edge of the tile and at the same time provides high resistance to pedestrian and vehicle traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZS/A/40
products.description: Projoint DIL NZS technical expansion joint is designed to protect the tile edge and easily withstand pedestrian and vehicle traffic. Thanks to its two parts, joined telescopically with special articulated fins, Projoint DIL NZS allows three-dimensional movement, tolerating movements of up to 5 millimetres. A very useful feature especially for workplaces and industrial settings. In particular, Projoint DIL NZS/A/40 model is the joint-covering version, with the same features, but intended for installation on already-existing flooring.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL NZS/L/
products.description: Projoint DIL NZS/L/ is an aluminium perimetral expansion joint specifically designed for industrial buildings. The element is part of the NZS technical joint line by Profilpas: these products consist of two telescopically joined parts with articulated fins capable of absorbing three-dimensional movements. These features allow expansion and compression movements of up to +/- 5 millimetres to be absorbed. Projoint DIL NZS/L/ is suitable for use in areas and surfaces subject to intense pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL PAS
products.description: Projoint DIL PAS is a structural joint composed of two L-shaped profiles in natural aluminium and an expanding part in interchangeable EPDM, available in black or grey.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL PBE
products.description: Projoint DIL PBE is a structural joint composed of two L-shaped profiles in natural aluminium and an expanding part in interchangeable plasticized PVC, available in black or grey. The two L-shaped profiles have drilled bases to allow the mechanical fixing with screws to the underlying structure.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL PBH
products.description: Projoint DIL PBH is a structural joint composed of two L-shaped profiles in natural aluminium and an expanding part in interchangeable EPDM, available in black or grey.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL PFFE
products.description: Projoint DIL PFFE is a load-bearing structural joint composed of two opposing profiles in natural aluminium and an expanding part (+/- 7 mm) in interchangeable plasticized PVC available in black or grey. The two L-shaped structures are provided with drilled bases (diam. 10 mm) to allow the mechanical fixing with screws included in the supply.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL PHDE
products.description: Projoint DIL PHDE is a structural joint composed of two interlocking and sliding profiles in natural aluminium. All profiles have drilled bases to allow the mechanical fixing with screws to the underlying structure and are designed to withstand structural movements of big buildings.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL STA
products.description: Splitting mortar-laid floors is made quicker, easier and more effective with the Projoint Dil STA/ expansion joint from Profilpas. Available in aluminium, it consists of a vulcanised EPDM inner section. The strength properties of the metal used for the structure make this product the ideal solution for completing and reinforcing surfaces that have to withstand great stress from pedestrian or vehicular traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROJOINT DIL STI
products.description: The strength and quality of steel enhanced by a vulcanised EPDM inner section: these are the features that make the Projoint Dil STI/ expansion joint particularly useful for splitting mortar-laid floors. The product has a metal structure that can easily withstand pedestrian and vehicle traffic (forklift trucks, pallet trucks and cars, etc.). These properties make Projoint Dil STI/ the ideal solution for finishing and reinforcing areas subject to the frequent passage of loads.

products.name: CERFIX PROLIST
products.description: Cerfix Prolist is a range of decorative listello tile trims designed and produced for wall coverings. The listello tile trims come in two different materials - steel and aluminium - which in turn have a wide choice of finishes. It is a line designed to create refined and attractive decorative effects on ceramic wall coverings and, thanks to their wide versatility, they prove to be perfect elements in any context. In fact, The Cerfix Prolist line of decorative listello tile trims can be successfully used in residential and public settings.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL L
products.description: Pronivel L is a profile used to join floors of different thicknesses (10mm) and of the same or different materials. It can be laid on existing floors using a simple and effective adhesive. There are also two versions of the profile, in aluminium or brass, to provide the best possible solution to a wide range of applications.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL M
products.description: Cerfix Pronivel M is a range of profiles designed to couple floors at different levels and prevent the unsightly and dangerous step that would otherwise be created. Available in aluminium, stainless steel and brass, these profiles are ideal to join carpeted or LVT floors. Thanks to the special shape, the Pronivel M MIN/ stainless steel profile can be used to finish and protect 135-degree external corners in tiled coverings.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL N
products.description: Pronivel N is a profile to join floors at different height (from 10 to 20mm), offering extreme flexibility. It has a load-bearing structure and two lips of different sizes which work together to reduce the step between two floors of different thicknesses. The many different combinations and articulated joint allow the perfect solution to be found for every requirement, and mean a new floor can also be overlaid, even after the profile has been inserted.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL P
products.description: Pronivel P is a profile used to join floors of different thicknesses,  to be inserted while the floor is being laid. It comes as aluminium, stainless steel and brass. The sloping section reduces the step, from 4.5mm to 20mm, caused by the different thickness in the two parts of the floor.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL PB
products.description: The Pronivel PB profile has a sloping edge and comes in several different heights, making it perfect to join floors of the same or different materials, at different heights (from 5mm to 15mm).  Pronivel PB, in silver anodised aluminium, is also ideal as a reducer between a floating LVT floor and another type of flooring.

products.name: CERFIX PRONIVEL PL
products.description:
Pronivel PL is a line of aluminium 
profiles to be used during the 
installation of ceramic or glued wood 
flooring and is suitable for connecting 
flooring of different thicknesses.

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND B
products.description: Proround B is a perimeter joint profile available in aluminium, stainless steel and PVC, suitable for wall coverings where a high level of hygiene must be maintained. This internal corner profile can be applied directly onto the already laid surface using special adhesives. It is the perfect solution during a renovation or for retrofitting already finished spaces. Proround B in stainless steel is particularly resistant to organic and inorganic attack and is especially suitable for hospitals, restaurants, canteens, food and chemical industries.

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND M
products.description: Proround M is an aluminium or stainless steel profile which acts as a connection between floor and wall covering. The cove-shaped design removes the 90° inside corner to prevent the build-up of dirt, a source of bacteria, creating a curved surface that makes daily cleaning easier and more efficient. The stainless steel version is recommended in spaces where a particular level of hygiene is required, such as hospitals, industrial kitchens, food industries and so on. In particular, AISI 316 DIN 1.4404 stainless steel is recommended for environments with higher chemical stress and in sea areas.

products.name: CERFIX PROROUND P
products.description: Proround P is a non-toxic, shock-proof PVC internal corner profile. This cove-shaped profile acts as a connection between floor and wall covering, preventing dirt from building up and facilitating corner cleaning. This profile is available with two anchor flanges for fixing to the wall, or with only one. The latter is suitable as a connector between floors and wall coverings of different thicknesses.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP G/705/F
products.description: Prostep G/705/F is an aluminium profile designed by Profilpas for  stairs covered with bonded LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile), to be installed at the same time as the covering is laid. Along with the other items in the Prostep and Protect range, this product is part of a full range of solutions and professional systems, designed specifically for this special type of floor.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SA-SB
products.description: Prostep SA and SB profiles are ideal  to lay and protect coverings on ceramic, cotto and stone coverings on steps. Available in different heights, to meet all requirements, these profiles have an aluminium base and a ridged PVC insert that can be replaced in the event of wear.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SAR-SIR
products.description: Prostep SAR and SIR are aluminium (SAR) and stainless steel (SIR) stair nosings, designed to protect the edges of steps and stairs. In addition, they can also be used as trims to protect the edges of external pavements.  The reversible shapes means Prostep SAR and SIR can be used with ceramic tiles of four different thicknesses.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SGI SGA SGN SGK
products.description: Prostep SGA, SGI, SGN and SGK were designed for use when laying ceramic tile, marble and stone steps, and to protect them. Thanks to the rounded profile, they add elegance and sophistication to step edges. So, as well as protection, they also add visual appeal.  These models come in aluminium, brass and stainless steel. The latter is recommended for situations with high foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SIS
products.description: Prostep SIS is a stainless steel profile designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. It guarantees excellent resistance to the main chemical and atmospheric agents. Prostep SIS is also especially recommended to protect steps subject to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SIX
products.description: Prostep SIX is a stainless steel profile designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. The application of Safety-Step non-slip strips on stair treads assures Prostep Six profiles are suitable for protecting steps in areas subjects to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SM SMA
products.description: Prostep SMA and SM are aluminium and natural brass profiles, designed to create and protect ceramic tile, marble or stone steps. Prostep SMA and SM are laid at the same time as the covering, to assure they are set seamlessly into it. Moreover, thanks to the knurled surface, they are also non-slip. These characteristics make Prostep SMA and SM suitable for a variety of settings, from private to public contexts subject to intense foot traffic.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SNG-SN
products.description: Prostep SNG and SN are aluminium (SNG) and brass (SN) profiles designed to build and protect, during the laying process, ceramic, marble and stone steps. Prostep SNG comes in the following heights: 8, 10, 12,5 and 15 millimetres, while Prostep SN is made in 8, 10 and 12.5 millimetres.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTEP SP
products.description: Prostep SP is a profile to build and protect, during the laying process, of ceramic, cotto and stone coverings on steps. Available in different heights (8, 10 or 12.5mm) and made from an aluminium base and a ridged PVC insert, Prostep SP guarantees a high degree of safety. The different colours of PVC means the product can be made to fit a variety of requirements.

products.name: CERFIX PROSTYLE
products.description: Prostyle is a range of profiles suitable for use as both a finish or decorative element on level ceramic tile, granite, marble and other kinds of floor. These profiles are also found as separation joints and a decorative feature between floors of different materials. Specifically, the stainless steel version acts as a protection for ceramic tiled steps and solves the problem of passing high loads that are typical in commercial and industrial settings.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPBV
products.description: Protec CPBV is a series of edge profiles for the protection and the finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium, they have been designed with a protruding section. In addition to protecting and finishing the outside edges, they guarantee the outflow of water from the floor, avoiding the contact with the outside border. They can be installed with tiles or marble of any thickness.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCV-CPCI
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPCV and CPCI are a series of edge profiles for the protection and the finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium (CPCV) and stainless steel (CPCI), they have been designed with a protruding section and can be used with tiles thicknesses up to 21 mm. In addition to protecting and finishing the outside edges, they guarantee the outflow of water from the floor, avoiding the contact with the outside border. Protec CPCV is also available in the bendable version CPCVF, provided with a special cutout that allows to bend the profile with a radius up to 1 meter.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCV/30/
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPCV/30 is an edging profile to protect and finish the outer edges of terraces and balconies. It is the solution for old terraces: the reduced dimensions of the protruding section allow to avoid removing the perimetral balustrades in case of refurbishment. This profile is available in colour-coated aluminium, for tile thicknesses up to 12.5 mm thick.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPCVD/30
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPCVD/30 is a draining perimeter profile, provided with a visible part that facilitates the outflow of rainwater from the tiled surface and an underlying protruding part equipped with holes for a further discharge of the water seeped under the tiles. The reduced dimensions of the visible part allow to avoid removing the perimetral balustrades in case of refurbishment.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPEV-CPEI
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPEV and CPEI are a series of edge reversible profiles for the protection and finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium (CPEV) and stainless steel (CPEI), they can be installed flush with the border or detached from it. They can be used with tiles or marble thicknesses from 11 to 32 mm. The particular section is recommended to protect the stair nosing and sidewalk edge, hiding the connection between tread and riser.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPGV
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPGV is a range of perimeter profiles made of painted aluminum for the protection and finishing of the external edges of terraces and balconies. The profile consists of a visible vertical section that facilitates the drainage of rainwater from the tiled surface and protects the edge of the flooring, and of a cantilevered section equipped with slotted holes that allow additional discharge of water filtered beneath the tiles. The maximum tile thickness suitable for installing Protec CPGV is 12.5 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPHA
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPHA - CPHV is an edge profile in anodised (CPHA) and colour-coated (CPHV) aluminium for terraces, balconies and pavements. The shape allows the outflow of water, avoiding the direct contact with the screed. Installed along the perimeter, it allows to outline ceramic tiles and to protect the border in many fields of use. It can be used with tiles thicknesses up to 21 mm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPLV
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPLV is a line of perimetral profiles in colour-coated aluminium, for the protection and finishing of the borders of outdoor raised floors, terraces or balconies. They are composed of a drilled base CPLB to be screwed to the supports, or, as an alternative, a cut base CPLB/2 for glued tiles, and a visible profile CPLV to be fixed with adhesive, available in 3 different heights according to the floor thickness. There are also special accessories for the creation of external corners and junctions.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPNV
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPNV is a series of edge profiles for the protection and the finishing of the outside edges of terraces and balconies. Available in colour-coated aluminium, they can be installed flush with the border or detached from it. Their special section makes them suitable for the protection of the borders of steps or sidewalks, since it hides the junction between the tread and the riser. Protec CPNV is also available in the bendable version CPNVF, provided with a special cutout that allows to bend the profile with a radius up to 40 cm.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPQV
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPQV is a range of perimeter profiles for the protection and finishing of the external edges of terraces and balconies. The profile features a visible vertical section that covers the edge of the flooring and allows the runoff of rainwater flowing over the tiled surface; additional slotted holes on the cantilevered section enable further drainage of water filtered beneath the tiles. This technical solution and the resulting drainage reduce problems related to freeze–thaw cycles and unsightly efflorescence that typically appears on cementitious grout joints. Suitable for tiles up to 12.5 mm thick.

products.name: CERFIX PROTEC CPVV
products.description: Cerfix Protec CPVV is a range of colour-coated aluminium perimeter profiles designed for the vertical closure of outdoor raised flooring systems. Cerfix Protec CPVV can also be used to protect and finish the outer edges of terraces and balconies where 20 mm-thick tiles are glued. The profiles are available in three colours (ash grey RAL 7038, ancient grey and stone) and in total heights of 100, 120 and 150 mm. The product range is completed by special components such as outside/inside corners and junctions.

products.name: CERFIX PROTOP
products.description: Profiles in the Protop range are used to finish and protect external corners and edges in tiled kitchens and worktops. Made of anodised aluminium, they are also perfect for tiled platforms and steps. Protop offer protection and are also part of the finishing details which undoubtedly make the difference in the kitchen.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM
products.description: Cerfix Protrim is a profile designed to seal and protect the external corners and edges of tiled floors, steps and platforms, it is available in aluminium, stainless steel, brass and PVC. The characteristic rounded shape makes Protrim profiles ideal as a symmetrical finish, but also as a safety feature around the corner and edge of the wall covering. Thanks to the large variety of finishes and materials, these items adapt perfectly to every style of interior. Of the many versions produced, there is also one in anti-bacterial painted aluminium, in compliance with ISO 22196:2011 standards. This special technology reduces the presence of bacteria by 99%.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM IP
products.description: Cerfix Protrim IP are minimalist profiles in aluminium or stainless steel, suitable for the edging of external corners that need the 45 degrees cut. These profiles allow a perfect installation both on wall coverings and on stairs or platforms in ceramic or wood.

products.name: CERFIX PROTRIM N
products.description: Cerfix Protrim N is a line of stainless steel external corner profiles with a slightly rounded shape. The special steel alloys used make Protrim N profiles perfect for use in a variety of settings: AISI 304 stainless steel is ideal for food production sites, kitchens and hospitals, while AISI 316 stainless steel - thanks to its resistance to the main chemical and atmospheric agents, chlorine and salt water - is recommended for swimming pools, spas and seaside areas.

products.name: DIY PROFILES
products.description: With its full range, Profilpas has provided an effective answer to the requirements of those needing to do home improvement work in domestic and industrial settings without the help of a professional.  In particular, Profilpas offers a huge range of DIY profiles, in a variety of materials, from aluminium to stainless steel and brass. Available in several commercial sizes, these products make light and easy work of the jobs to be done, guaranteeing Profilpas quality at every stage. The following profiles appear in more detail in the Profilpas catalogue: Flat Corner L-shaped U-shaped drainage channel Double U-shaped drainage channel Bull nose Round tube Square tube Rectangular tube T-profile Round profile Square profile In addition to these, the range also includes profiles for silver anodised aluminium structures and counterweights for rounded shower curtain rails.

products.name: ELECTRIC VACUUM SUCTION CUP
products.description: Multi-purpose electric suction cup used to handle and move ceramic tiles, marble and natural stone slabs, glass and other objects.

products.name: FIX LEVEL
products.description: Fix Level is a screw levelling system for floors and coverings of different thickness, particularly suitable for large size tiles. The cylinder incorporates a disk for the protection of the covering surface against scratches during the levelling phase.

products.name: GLASS PROFILE GPS
products.description: Glass Profile is a line of stainless steel profiles for the creation of floor-level shower surfaces. Glass Profile creates a coplanar surface characterized by a modern and linear design, by covering the difference in height of the surface with 2% slope. The range includes two finishes: brushed stainless steel and matt black colour coated stainless steel. The versatility of these two colours become guarantee of elegance, assuring a minimalist and trendy effect. GPS1 : profiles to be installed between the tiled sloped floor and the glass wall; GPS2 - GPS14 : profiles to be installed between the tiled wall and the glass wall; GPS3 : profiles for the sloped sides of open space showers; GPS4 : profiles to be installed between the tiled sloped floor and the side tiled wall; GPS5 : profiles to be installed between the tiled sloped floor and the frontal tiled wall.

products.name: KLIC LEVEL
products.description: Klic Level è un sistema di livellamento a vite per pavimenti e rivestimenti di diverso spessore, particolarmente adatto per piastrelle di grande formato. Il cilindro incorpora un disco per la protezione della superficie del rivestimento dai graffi durante la fase di livellamento e un meccanismo funzionale per un rapido inserimento ed espulsione dell'elemento monouso.

products.name: MAGNETIC KIT K10
products.description: K10 is a magnetic kit designed for the creation of concealed, removable inspection panels within ceramic tile installations. Ideal for accessing plumbing manifolds, hydraulic systems and technical compartments while preserving the aesthetics and continuity of the tiled surface.

products.name: METAL LINE 100
products.description: Metal Line 100 is an anodised aluminium skirting board that comes in two heights, designed for attachment to panel walls and plasterboard. Thanks to the clean, essential form, it slots in easily to any setting.  It is easy to fit using specific adhesives. The final effect is of a recessed skirting board, set into the wall.

products.name: METAL LINE 101
products.description: Metal Line 101 is an anodised aluminium recessed skirting board, ideal for rendered walls. It is fitted to the unfinished wall, using specific adhesives before the final render is applied. The render coat, which covers the top of the skirting board, produces a recessed-type baseboard, set into the wall. This skirting board delineates the perimeter of the room, with no protrusions and non-invasively.

products.name: METAL LINE 105
products.description: Metal Line 105 è un battiscopa caratterizzato da un semplice e rapido sistema di installazione ad incastro sul profilo base per fissaggio art. 105/CB in PVC coestruso fissato a parete mediante l’utilizzo di viti e tasselli. Oltre ad avere una funzione decorativa soddisfa pienamente le esigenze di carattere tecnico permettendo di nascondere imprecisioni di posa e lasciando piccoli spazi di dilatazione perimetrale in pavimentazioni. Sono disponibili speciali componenti per la realizzazione di raccordi con funzione di angoli esterni, angoli interni, giunzioni e terminali, creando uniformità e linearità di finitura.

products.name: METAL LINE 790
products.description: Metal Line 790 is a skirting board in polished or brushed stainless steel, available in different heights, that follows the minimalist trends of modern design. Thanks to the curved section, this skirting board perfectly hides the perimetral expansion gap of a floating floor. Metal Line 790 can be easily and quickly installed through specific adhesives.

products.name: METAL LINE 87/6-88/6
products.description: Metal Line 87/6 and 88/6 are two flush recessed skirting boards for plaster and plasterboards. Both are composed of two separate elements: a base in natural aluminium and an insert in silver anodised or matt white colour-coated aluminium. Once installed, the skirting board integrates perfectly into the wall surface, outlining the perimeter of the space without limiting it. There are two different phases of installation: the base element must be installed when the room is still in its rough state, while the chosen insert must be put after the laying of the floor.

products.name: METAL LINE 89
products.description: Metal Line 89 is a skirting board in aluminium, in different finishes, characterized by square and minimalist lines; available in different heights, it outlines the space with simplicity and elegance. Fixed on the wall through specific adhesives, it perfectly hides the perimetral expansion gap of a floating floor, as well as having a decorative role. Metal Line 89 is also available in white and black Trend Color Stone, two matt colours that perfectly combines with the most modern ceramic coverings.

products.name: METAL LINE 89/613
products.description: Metal Line 89/613 is an anodised or white-painted aluminium skirting board with a characteristic boxy, minimal design. The 13mm thickness means it sits over the edge of the floor covering perfectly and hides the gap needed for floating floors to expand. Metal Line 89/613 also has special pieces for use as internal and external angles, or end caps, and can be fixed to the wall using a suitable adhesive.

products.name: METAL LINE 90
products.description: Metal Line 90 is an aluminium skirting board, available in different finishes, that creates an elegant junction between the wall and the floor. Thanks to the curved section, this skirting board perfectly hides the perimetral expansion gap of a floating floor. Metal Line 90 is also available in white and black Trend Color Stone, two matt colours that perfectly match the most modern ceramic coverings. All the models can be curved through the specific Proflex Machine.

products.name: METAL LINE 92
products.description: Metal Line 92 is an aluminium skirting board of simple design and softly rounded shape, which creates the perfect floor-to-wall joint. It is easy to install thanks to the quick-coupling system using either natural aluminium or PVC, which screws to the wall.

products.name: METAL LINE 93
products.description:
Metal line 93, in silver-coloured anodized aluminium, with a simple, linear design, creates an impeccable floor-wall joint.
Quick and easy to install with coupling system onto natural aluminium supports screwed to the wall.

products.name: METAL LINE 94
products.description:
Metal Line 94/7SF is a skirting board with a section
that facilitates fixing to the wall with cement-based adhesives.

products.name: METAL LINE 95
products.description: Metal Line 95 is an aluminium skirting board that comes in two different sizes and turns the floor-to-wall joint into an elegant frame. The skirting board is practical and functional. The click-coupling system onto a natural aluminium base which screws to the wall, makes it easy to maintain. Moreover, Metal Line 95 comes with special parts for use as internal corner, external corner and right/left end caps.

products.name: METAL LINE 97/4
products.description: Metal Line 97 is an aluminium skirting board with a minimal, low-key style, creating a floor-to-wall joint that is very discreet and suitable for any interior. Metal Line 97/8 also features an optional PVC trunking which screws to the wall and can be used to support the skirting board.

products.name: METAL LINE 97/7
products.description:
Metal line 97/ 7, in anodized aluminium, with a simple, linear design, creates an impeccable floor-wall joint.
These profiles feature a quick and easy snap-on installation system using a natural, wall-mounted aluminium base.

products.name: METAL LINE 97/8
products.description: Metal Line 97/8, made of anodised aluminium, perfectly outlines the junction between wall and floor. It is quick and easy to install using natural aluminium supports fixed to the wall with screws and plugs.

products.name: METAL LINE 98
products.description: Metal Line 98 is an aluminium skirting board that stands out for its soft and elegant shape, characterised by a protruding lower wing and a slightly rounded upper part. Installation is simple thanks to the practical interlocking system on natural aluminium supports, to be fixed to the wall with screws and plugs. Metal Line 98 is equipped with special pieces for creating inside and outside corners, junctions and end caps.

products.name: METAL LINE AF - M DESIGN
products.description: Metal Line AF M Design is an aluminium finishing element that emphasises the meeting point between wall and floor coverings, even of different materials, and can also be used as a decorative listello tile trim for ceramic wall coverings. Metal Line AF M Design is characterized by a recess that creates a shadow, which in turn is reflected in the aluminium of the element itself. This profile is ideal for projects where a modern, design-oriented style with undeniable impact is preferred.

products.name: PP DRAIN AQUA
products.description: The linear drains for floor-level showers PP Drain Aqua, made of stainless steel AISI 316 and provided with a patented removable siphon in antibacterial ABS, are a perfect synthesis of beauty and practicality. Profilpas has taken care of every aspect of their design, production and quality control, to offer a product that is always efficient and aesthetically perfect. The linear shower drains PP Drain Aqua, composed of a single piece without welds, distinguish for their design and functionality that make them elegant, simple to install and easy to clean. Each part of the shower drain is studied in detail, to contain in few components all that is needed to guarantee the maximum ease of installation and maintenance.

products.name: PP DRAIN VARIOGUARD
products.description: PP Drain Varioguard is a floor-level shower drain made of AISI 304 stainless steel. Adjustable in both length and height, this drain offers maximum flexibility, meeting any technical and aesthetic requirement. It is also easy to clean thanks to the removable siphon. PP Drain Varioguard is an extremely practical and versatile linear drain, adaptable to any installation method. From start to finish, this product adapts flexibly to different situations. Furthermore, everything you need is included in the package.

products.name: PP LEVEL DUO MAXI
products.description: PP level DUO MAXI is the range of adjustable supports for outdoor raised floors by Profilpas. A complete range able to satisfy any installation requirement, from ceramic tiles to single- and multi-format ceramic planks, including decking. PP level DUO MAXI is the ideal solution for those looking for maximum flexibility, strength and stability, ensuring a smooth and fast installation for a perfect result.

products.name: PP LEVEL DUO MAXI – DECKING
products.description: PP level DUO MAXI - DECKING is the ideal solution for creating terraces, pool side floor and walkways that require stable, durable and aesthetically flawless decking surfaces. The system, which includes supports, aluminium joists and a wide range of accessories, makes it easy and precise to install raised outdoor decking using self-supporting boards in various sizes, made from WPC or timber. This ensures maximum aesthetic and functional versatility.

products.name: PP LEVEL DUO MAXI – DRAINAGE JOIST
products.description: PP level DUO MAXI – DRAINAGE JOIST is the ideal system for creating terraces, poolside areas and walkways that require maximum stability even at significant heights, whilst ensuring optimal drainage of rainwater. Thanks to the combination of adjustable supports, aluminium joists and dedicated accessories, the system allows for the installation of outdoor raised floors using self-supporting slabs in ceramic, natural stone or concrete, in a wide range of sizes. PP level DUO MAXI – DRAINAGE JOIST is also particularly suitable for installing large-format slabs, ensuring a flawless and long-lasting installation.

products.name: PP LEVEL DUO MAXI – JOIST
products.description: PP level DUO MAXI – JOIST is the ideal system for creating terraces, poolside areas and walkways that require maximum stability, even at significant heights. Thanks to the combination of adjustable supports, aluminium joists and dedicated accessories, the system allows for the installation of outdoor raised floors using self-supporting slabs in ceramic, natural stone or concrete, in a wide range of sizes. PP level DUO MAXI – JOIST is also particularly suitable for installing large-format slabs, ensuring a flawless and long-lasting installation.

products.name: PP LEVEL GRID
products.description: With the PP level GRID safety grid, installing ceramic tiles and/or stone slabs of different sizes and in different directions will no longer be a problem. In fact, this outdoor raised floor installation tool provides maximum installation flexibility, increased safety in case of slab fragmentation, and improved load distribution.

products.name: PP LEVEL MAXI FIX
products.description: PP level DUO MAXI is the range of adjustable supports for outdoor raised floors by Profilpas. A complete range able to satisfy any installation requirement, from ceramic tiles to single- and multi-format ceramic planks, including decking. PP level DUO MAXI is the ideal solution for those looking for maximum flexibility, strength and stability, ensuring a smooth and fast installation for a perfect result.

products.name: PP LEVEL MINI
products.description: PP level MINI is a range of adjustable fixed-head supports for outdoor raised floors with reduced heights for self-supporting tile floors or decking coverings.

products.name: PP LEVEL SP
products.description: SP1 is a support with fixed height of 14 mm. It is the simplest and cheapest solution for installing any self-supporting outdoor flooring. According to the conformation of the subfloor, it can be used with SP2 (1 mm thick) and SP3 (3 mm thick) levellers.

products.name: PRESTOWOOD
products.description: One of the products Profilpas makes for wooden and laminate floors is the Prestowood range of adhesive profiles. Model 22/A is part of an easy-to-install range designed to provide joints between floors of same height. Model 50/A is perfect for coupling floors at different levels, while Prestowood 63/A, 74/A and 58/A are ideal for steps in existing wood floors. All of these solutions are made of anodised aluminium, or coated with Alcrom® Plus film, and are equally practical for DIY use.

products.name: PROCLASSIC F
products.description: Proclassic F is a range of threshold profiles with a flat cross-section, designed to hide the joint between two sections of floor of different materials. Without the convex shape, it can be used under doors and the non-slip knurled surface helps to increase safety. Proclassic F is available in aluminium and brass, in widths from 15mm to 40mm.

products.name: PROCLASSIC FIRE LEVEL
products.description: Proclassic Fire Level is a range of stainless steel AISI 316 profiles designed to be installed at the base of fire-rated doors or any door that requires a non-combustible transition element. With a thickness of 2.5 mm, it is intended to be positioned during the flooring installation to ensure a seamless, level connection with resilient floor coverings.

products.name: PROCLASSIC FIRE TOP
products.description: Proclassic Fire Top is a line of profiles made of AISI 316 stainless steel, designed to be used as a threshold for fire doors and all doors that require a non-combustible threshold. With a thickness of 2 mm, Proclassic Fire Top is engineered to be installed over existing flooring, whether resilient, textile, or pre-installed wood, including self-laying types, as long as they are not click-lock systems.

products.name: PROCLASSIC R
products.description: Proclassic R is a range of threshold profiles which hide any cutting or laying imperfections in floors sections of different materials, such as the linking of wood and tiles. The convex surface of these profiles helps to offset any 2-3mm differences in height between the two types of floor. Moreover, they are especially easy to lay with either adhesive or screw-fixing. The stainless steel version is recommended for public and private places, and the gleam of the material makes the profiles a great match for the latest in contemporary floors.

products.name: PROFIX THIN C/4
products.description: The Profilpas product collection designed for LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors includes Profix Thin, the dedicated floating floor system for 4-6mm thick floors. In particular, Profix Thin C/4 is a threshold profile in anodised aluminium for floors of different heights, available in a selection of colours with Alcrom® Plus decorations. C/4 comprises a top profile coupled to a PVC base.

products.name: PROFIX THIN S/4
products.description: Profix Thin S/4 is an end trim which - along with threshold profiles Z/4 and C/4 - completes the Profilpas Profix Thin range for LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floors. Profix Thin S/4, like all other solutions in this LVT floating floor system, in thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm, comes in different colours of anodised aluminium and with Alcrom® Plus finishes. S/4 also has a top profile coupled to a PVC base.

products.name: PROFIX THIN Z/4
products.description: The Z/4 threshold profile for floors of equal level is part of Profix Thin, the system to lay LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile) floating floors of thicknesses from 4mm to 6mm.   Like the C/4 threshold profile for floors of different heights and S/4 end trim, Profix Thin Z/4 comes with different anodised aluminium and Alcrom® Plus finishes, a wide selection of wood, stone or cement decorations to personalize your profile. C/4 also has a top profile coupled to a PVC base.

products.name: PROFLEX LINE
products.description: Prostep Flex is one of the products in the wide range of bendable profiles by Profilpas, able to adapt perfectly to any kind of curvature. In particular, Prostep Flex is a bendable profile for steps or platforms which have a curved edge. Made of aluminium with various finishes, it can be used, like all solutions in the range, together with the Proflex machine, designed to model profiles and give them a curved shape.

products.name: PROFLEX MACHINE
products.description: Proflex Machine is designed and built to form Profilpas Flex profiles into curved shapes. The machine comes with a kit, and additional kits are available if you wish to bend Metal Line 90/.

products.name: PROJOINT
products.description: Projoint is a range of separation joints in stainless steel and brass which are perfect for use in areas subject to heavy and frequent loads. Thanks to the simple cross-section, they insert perfectly between floor sections in different materials. Moreover, the stainless steel version can be inserted and polished even after the floor has been cut and laid. Projoint joints are available in different sizes to assure they fit perfectly with the many types of floors to be joined.

products.name: PROJOINT M
products.description: Projoint M is a joint to uncouple and decorate level floors laid with bonded or mortar floors. In aluminium or natural brass, when used between floors of different heights and types, Projoint M has a visible depth of 5 or 10mm, allowing for polishing in both versions.

products.name: PROJOINT R
products.description: Projoint R profiles were designed to split and decorate level granite, wood, tile, marble or other types of floor, and uncouple floors of different materials. The thickness at the top makes them ideal for floors needing polishing, like marble, Venetian and wood.

products.name: PROJOINT T
products.description: Projoint T is the range of profiles specifically for uncoupling, protecting and decorating level floors in different kinds of material, like tiles, marble, granite or wood. This range of profiles for floors of the same height can also be used to hide any imperfections due to the cutting or laying of different materials. The particular cross-section makes Projoint T ideal to offset any slight slopes caused by the coupling of different kinds of floors. The T-shaped cross-section also creates a perfect anchor with sealants and adhesives.

products.name: PROJOINT U
products.description: Projoint U separation joints, available in stainless steel and brass, are ideal for floors subject to frequent passing heavy loads. The distinctive cross-section of these joints makes them easy to install and extremely practical, they slot seamlessly into the floor to create an even surface.

products.name: PROLEVEL HIGH
products.description: Finding the right joint for floors of different height is no longer a problem with the Prolevel High range of profiles by Profilpas. These products provide a quick and easy solution to unsightly and inconvenient steps between existing floors, up to 16mm in size. The distinctive feature of the range is the high degree of flexibility and different application modes to fit any requirement. The numerous versions come in stainless steel, brass and aluminium.

products.name: PROLEVEL MEDIUM
products.description: Prolevel Medium is the ideal solution for joining existing floors of low thickness. The profiles - in stainless steel, aluminium or brass - quickly eliminate any unsightly height differences, from 4mm to 6mm, and also come in blister packs (with adhesive or screws); these characteristics assure they are easy to apply and also ideal for DIY use.

products.name: PROLEVEL THIN
products.description: Prolevel Thin is a range of profiles designed to create joints in PVC floors of different height. These aluminium products, to be fitted after the floor has been laid, are perfect for protecting fragile floor edges from any impact or stress.

products.name: PROLIGHT ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS AND ACCESSORIES
products.description: To complement the Prolight range, which includes light skirting boards with integrated LED technology, Profilpas presents a series of compatible electrical components and accessories. Each element should be selected to match the profile to be installed, bearing in the mind the length and W/m consumption, also needed to select the power unit of the dimmer and controller. The extensive selection made by Profilpas includes strip LED coils, power packs, dimmers, boosters, remote controls, control units, electric cables and connectors.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE 88/I6L/A
products.description: Prolight Metal Line 88/I6L/A is a flush recessed skirting board with integrated strip LED lighting, available in height 60mm. Thanks to the distinctive design, light is distributed along the length of the skirting board through a slim slit, left intentionally visible. A dimmer can also be added to adjust the brightness of the light and use the board as a decorative feature or safety night light.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE 89
products.description: Prolight Metal Line 89 is an aluminium skirting board featuring an LED strip lighting system. Thanks to a diffuser element, the light is distributed along the entire length of the profile. Prolight Metal Line 89 is available in a height of 60 millimetres and offers the option of fitting a dimmer switch, allowing you to adjust the skirting board’s light intensity to serve as an elegant decorative feature or provide night-time courtesy lighting.

products.name: PROLIGHT METAL LINE SKL/2
products.description: Prolight Metal Line S SKL/2 is an aluminium skirting board with indirect LED light. Its special section allows to create an original play of light along the wall and adds value to the whole surface. In addition to the silver anodised this profile is available in different colour-coated aluminium finishes including original cement effects, 2 special metal tonalities and a white characterized by an extremely solid and full colour.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROANGLE Q
products.description: Prolight Proangle Q is a led light profile for external corners with a natural aluminium base, complete with opaline PVD diffuser, available in four colours. In addition to sealing and protecting external corners of tiled wall coverings, to avoid unsightly and delicate 45-degree tile edges, this profile can also be used make public and private locations safer, thanks to the integrated LED strip lighting.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST CLA
products.description: Prolist CLA, a silver anodised aluminium profile with strip LED lighting is also part of the vast Prolight range of LED light profiles. CLA Prolist was designed to cast a pleasant and soft band of light onto wall units, kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes and stands, thanks to the integrated diffuser. Prolist CLA is also available as an adhesive version, in CLA/8A. In connection with these, Profilpas supplies CLA/8P edging, also in anodised aluminium.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST LLA-LLB
products.description: Prolight Prolist is a range of listello tile trims which are perfect for embellishing walls, shelves, wardrobes, mirrors, and is ideal for bathrooms and kitchens. Elements in the Prolight Prolist range have an integrated LED light, either direct or indirect, and are available in aluminium.  Each model has its own end trim, for an impeccable end result.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST LQL-2
products.description:
Prolight Prolist Q LQL/2 is an aluminium decorative listello with indirect LED light that, thanks to its particular section, creates a delicate and
elegant line of light on large-size ceramic slabs, thus embellishing the wall.
This profile is available in different colour-coated aluminium finishes including original cement effects, 2 special metal tonalities and a white
characterized by an extremely solid and full colour.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROLIST TLA-TLB
products.description:
Prolight Prolist TLA and TLB are listello tile trims made of anodized and polished silver finish aluminium, with a strip LED lighting system.
Light is distributed along the length of the profile through a downlighter fixed to the side of the profile, making the item especially suited to
bathrooms, kitchens, alcoves, etc.
End pieces are available to seal the profiles at either end.
If you also add a dimmer (optional) the intensity of the lighting can be adjusted as a decorative feature or to provide a night light

products.name: PROLIGHT PROSTEP SGA/11L
products.description: Prolight Prostep SGA/11L is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, by Profilpas. Prostep SGA/11L is part of the Prolight Prostep range of stair nosings to be laid at the same time as the covering, featuring an LED element which creates an interesting downlight effect.   The rounded shape of Prostep SGA/11L sets it apart from other stair nosings in the Prolight Prostep range, and gives the step a touch of class without having to forego safety.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROTECT 126/L/F
products.description: Prolight Protect 126/L/F is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, to be laid at the same time as the covering. This item has an integrated LED light, providing an excellent solution to the need for light in public spaces like clubs, cinemas, offices, boats and much more. Protect 126/L/F is unlike other stair nosing models on account of the non-slip ridged rubber on the stair tread, combining design with a high standard of safety.

products.name: PROLIGHT PROTECT G/9/F
products.description: Prolight Protect G/9/F is a light stair nosing in silver anodised aluminium, to be laid at the same time as the covering. This article is made of silver anodised aluminium and thanks to the horizontal  light emitted from the integrated LED, it provides an excellent solution to the need for light and safety in public spaces like clubs, cinemas, offices, boats and much more.

products.name: PROMAT
products.description: Promat is a modular technical mat, which can be customized and created in any size directly on site, allowing maximum operational flexibility. The installation of Promat is easy and quick thanks to the interlocking system with silver anodised aluminium profiles, already equipped with textile, PVC or brush insert. The textile insert, recommended for internal use, absorbs finer dirt and water, and also aids drying when passing through. The PVC insert is resistant to atmospheric agents, making it ideal for outdoor use, removes coarse dirt and also has a non-slip function. Lastly, the brush insert is suitable for outdoor installation in area of high pedestrian traffic thanks to its ability to remove the most difficult dirt. Promat can be installed recessed or overlapped on existing floors according to the needs. In case of overlapping installation, there is the possibility to insert the ramp profile for facilitating the access. Promat is also available in two already-assembled and ready-for-use versions in a choice of textile or PVC/brush mix, in sizes 70x39,5 cm and 90x49,5 cm.

products.name: PROSTAIR
products.description: An elegant, classic and timeless solution, Prostairis a complete system of profiles and associated accessories to anchor stair rods. Designed by Profilpas, they are available in different materials, from aluminium to brass, providing a quick, efficient answer to multiple requirements. The huge selection of anchoring accessories completes the product and assures the rods can be quickly removed for regular cleaning or when they need to be replaced.

products.name: PROTECT 111-75
products.description: Protect 111 and 75 are discreet and functional aluminium profiles, designed to help lay and protect low-thickness coverings on stairs. Designed specially to be the right size for low thickness coverings, they are also recommended for thin LVT coverings.

products.name: PROTECT 124
products.description: Protect 124 are anodised aluminium profiles to provide effective protection for the edges of existing ceramic, marble, wood or carpeted steps. Characterized by a black Safety-Step non-slip insert, Protect 124 profiles are ideal for public spaces must meet regulations.

products.name: PROTECT 126
products.description: To protect the edges of existing tiled, marble, wood or carpet steps, Profilpas has perfected a specific range of profiles which includes Protect 126. In silver anodised aluminium, with a replaceable rubber insert, Protect 126 are advised when building public spaces to safety standards.

products.name: PROTECT 130
products.description: To protect the edges of existing wood, ceramic tile or marble steps, Profilpas has created 130 stair nosings in the Protect range. These two anodised aluminium profiles are suitable for public spaces which must comply with regulations. In terms of fixing, they come pre-drilled or for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 150-151-152-154
products.description: Protect models 150, 151, 152 e 154 are part of the wide range of profiles that Profilpas makes for stairs. These PVC profiles are ideal to protect the edges of stairs made in different materials: ceramic tile, marble, wood, PVC, linoleum, carpeting and LVT. The different colours available mean they will fit perfectly into any space and can be applied during or after the covering has been laid.

products.name: PROTECT 155
products.description: Protect 155 profiles are PVC profiles built to protect, define and finish the edges of existing tiled, marble, stone, wooden, carpeted, linoleum, PVC or LVT steps. Available in a selection of colours and with a knurled surface, these profiles offer an excellent non-slip solution and meet the requirements of a variety of applications.

products.name: PROTECT 156
products.description: PVC stair nosing profiles Protect 156 play an important role in protecting the edge of tiled, marble, wood, carpeted or other kinds of steps, and are placed during the laying process to make sure they are set into the step covering. Available in black, grey and brown, these profiles offer a solution that meets a number of different requirements. Protect 156 profiles come in different formats and dimensions to assure they can be adapted to different sizes and types of coverings.

products.name: PROTECT 70-71
products.description: Protect anodised aluminium profiles 70 and 71 are suitable to protect the corners of existing wood, ceramic tile or marble steps. They are an excellent solution when public spaces must comply with safety regulations. They come pre-drilled to be secured with screws or without holes for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 72
products.description: Protect 72 is an anodised aluminium stair nosing with a replaceable rubber insert: its specific features make it ideal to protect the edges of existing ceramic tile, marble, wood or carpeted stairs. Protect 72 guarantees safety and comes in a pre-drilled version making it the ideal solution for public spaces which must meet safety regulations.

products.name: PROTECT 73-74-58
products.description: Protect 73, 74 and 58 are profiles to protect the corners of existing wood, ceramic tile or marble stairs. They are available, depending on the model, with various finishes and in different sizes, to meet every possible aesthetic and functional requirement. Each model comes pre-drilled or for application with adhesive.

products.name: PROTECT 76-110
products.description: Protect 76 and 110 are anodised aluminium profiles to protect the edges of existing ceramic, marble, wood or carpeted steps. These models have a Safety-Step non-slip tape, 19mm wide, replaceable in the event of wear or maintenance. Thanks to this element, Protect 76 and 110 stair nosings are the ideal solution for public spaces which must meet safety regulations.

products.name: PROTECT 78
products.description: Protect 78 is one of the solutions making up the Profilpas range of stair profiles. It is an anodised aluminium profile, used to protect the edges of existing ceramic, marble, wood or carpeted steps. The replaceable rubber insert offers greater safety by removing any risk of slipping, and makes Protect 78 is suitable for use in public spaces. It is 48mm wide and 40cm high.

products.name: PROTECT 79-125
products.description: The extensive Profilpas range of stair profiles also includes Protect 79 and 125. These anodised aluminium profiles have a ridged rubber insert, which can be replaced, and are perfect for protecting the edges of existing steps in different materials, like ceramic tile, wood, marble and carpet. They are especially recommended for public spaces which must meet safety regulations regarding non-slip steps.

products.name: PROTECT 80
products.description: Protect 80 by Profilpas, in anodised aluminium with a non-slip Safety-Step tape, was designed to provide greater protection at the edges of existing ceramic tile, marble, wood and carpeted steps. The profile is suitable for use in public spaces which must meet safety standards.

products.name: PROTECT 87 -370-373
products.description: Protect 87, 370 and 373 profiles are part of the Profilpas range of stair profiles, designed as solutions to assure protection, safety and a pleasant finish. These models are non-slip and come pre-drilled or for application with adhesive. Protect 87 / in silver anodised aluminium measures 20x20, Protect 370 / is polished brass and also measures 20x20, and Protect 373/ is polished brass measuring 30x30.

products.name: PROTILER
products.description: Protiler is a levelling system for the laying of ceramic and stone tiles. It is suitable for thicknesses from 3 to 20 mm and impedes the vertical movement between tiles during the adhesive grip phase. Specific pliers are available for the laying of floors and coverings for less effort and saving time.

products.name: PVC LINE 148-172-173
products.description: PVC Line 148 is a skirting board by Profilpas, suitable for finishing, decorating and protecting carpet and PVC floor coverings. It comprises two parts: a hard PVC base and a soft PVC clip. Used as a hygienic corner profile, once fitted and the covering relaid, it forms a rounded shield. The skirting board also acts as a finish, covering the edge of the carpet and PVC laid, and hiding any uneven cuts. On account of these characteristics, it is especially suited for communities, hospitals and schools.

products.name: PVC LINE 170-169-171
products.description: PVC Line 170, 169 and 171 are part of a range of plasticised PVC cove joints.  These Profilpas products are particularly recommended for laying carpeting and PVC - they can,  in fact, effectively level any curving between the floor and covering. They stand out for their versatility: thanks to the many different sizes and shapes available, they is something for every requirement.

products.name: PVC LINE 8181
products.description:
PVC Line 8181 is a 70 mm high skirting board in plastic-coated PVC, characterized by a special shape that makes it suitable for installation on
curved walls.
8181 is particularly suitable for DIY installation, thanks to its quick and easy application.
Available in different colours, it can be fixed to the wall with neoprene adhesive.

products.name: PVC LINE 8596 - 8598
products.description: PVC Line 8596 and 8598 are part of a range of PVC foam skirting boards which are shock-resistant and able to provide adequate protection for walls. They are 14mm thick and 60mm and 80mm, respectively, high. The striking features are the shape and soft backing material which allow the board to adhere smoothly to any kind of support, even when not perfectly flat, making them quick and easy to fit.  They come in different colours and can be laid with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55).

products.name: PVC LINE 8600
products.description: PVC Line 8600 is a range of shock-proof foam PVC skirting boards. 70mm high and 9mm thick, these Profilpas components can also suitable for DIY use thanks to the ease and speed with which they can be laid and fixed with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55). As well as providing protection, 8600 also allows you to personalize any room, thanks to the choice of colours available.

products.name: PVC LINE 8602
products.description: PVC Line 8602 is a foam PVC skirting board offering a high degree of impact resistance. Being 48m high, the product effectively protects walls and is also easy to fit using a click system and spring steel clips: these elements make PVC Line 8602 ideal for DIY use. Being 19mm thick, the skirting board can also hide any expansion along the edge of floating wood and laminate floors.

products.name: PVC LINE 8603
products.description: PVC Line 8603 is a 70mm high foam PVC skirting board. This skirting board is extremely shock-resistant and features a quick and easy click assembly system using harmonic steel clips.  8603 is especially recommended for floating wood and laminate floors, as its 15mm size covers any expansion along the edge. As well as being practical, this skirting board is also an excellent decorative feature, available in many different colours.

products.name: PVC LINE 8605-8606
products.description: PVC Line 8605 and 8606 are two skirting boards in co-extruded PVC, characterized by a rounded shape and a 70-mm height. Both are composed of a core in foam PVC and a visible surface in coloured rigid PVC to guarantee the best aesthetic result and colour uniformity. 8605 can also be covered with Alcrom® Plus film and can be further customized thanks to the digital printing technology Profilpas Digital System . 8505 and 8606 can be fixed to the wall with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55) or nails. Moreover, they do not absorb water and are resistant to impact, wear and tear, UV rays and the products normally used for cleaning floors and wall coverings.

products.name: PVC LINE 8607
products.description: The PVC Line 8607 foam PVC skirting board is shock-resistant and provides effective protection for surfaces and walls.
