The simple click coupling system using spring steel clips makes it quick to install and especially well suited for DIY. The 70mm PVC Line 8607 foam PVC skirting board comes in different colours and, thanks to its 19mm height, it can cover any expansion along the edge of floating wood and laminate floors.

products.name: PVC LINE 8608
products.description: PVC Line 8608 is a foam PVC skirting board, coated with Alcrom® Plus film. Available in 43 different patterns, it can be further personalized for minimum orders of 500m. 8608 is impervious to water, resistant to shock, wear and UV rays, and also to detergents. As regards mounting, it can be bonded, nailed or clipped to the wall.

products.name: PVC LINE 8612
products.description: PVC Line 8612 is a foam PVC skirting board covered with Alcrom®  Plus film, suitable for both ceramic and LVT floors. It can be fixed to the wall with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55).

products.name: PVC LINE 8613
products.description: PVC Line 8613 is a foam PVC skirting board covered with Alcrom® Plus film, suitable for wooden floors. It can be fixed to the wall with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55) or fixing clip 8608/C.

products.name: PVC LINE 8614
products.description: PVC Line 8614, coated with white Alcrom® Plus film, is part of the range of PVC skirting boards by Profilpas, and is ideal for renovation projects. It was designed to be installed on top of existing tiled or wooden skirting boards that are to be covered rather than removed. 90mm high and 20mm wide, it can be fixed to the skirting board that you want to hide using a simple adhesive.

products.name: PVC LINE 8615-8616
products.description: PVC Line 8615 and 8616 are two skirting boards in co-extruded PVC, characterized by a square shape and a 70-mm height. Both are composed of a core in foam PVC and a visible surface in coloured rigid PVC to guarantee the best aesthetic result and colour uniformity. They can also be covered with Alcrom® Plus film and can be further customized thanks to the digital printing technology Profilpas Digital System . 8515 and 8616 can be fixed to the wall with adhesive (like MS 45 or MS 55) or nails. Moreover, they do not absorb water and are resistant to impact, wear and tear, UV rays and the products normally used for cleaning floors and wall coverings.

products.name: Q DRAIN
products.description: The advantages of a floor-level shower are not just aesthetic, designed to make the bathroom more elegant and unique. Their great practicality is also worthy of note. With this in mind, Profilpas introduced Q Drain,  a range of easy-to-fit floor-level shower drain systems, giving you the freedom to personalize the floor and wall coverings used in the shower. There are four versions available (Classic, Cube, Line and Tile) and each one has an integrated waterproofing membrane and drains manufactured to EN 1253-1 (minimum flow rate of 24 l/min).

products.name: RAISED TILE PROTECTOR
products.description: Super hydrophobic treatment with high contact angle, solvent-free, which significantly reduces water pooling on outdoor raised floors. Product with very low VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) emissions, with a view to protecting the health of both applicators and end users, EC1 Plus certified.

products.name: SAFETY-STEP
products.description: Safety-Step non-slip strips are formed of abrasive particles held together by synthetic resins on a dimensionally stable support. Self-adhesive and easy to apply, the Safety-Step non-slip strips are perfect for any surface subject to intense vehicle and pedestrian traffic, like stairs, entrances to offices and apartment buildings, ramps, walkways, elevators, machine platforms, emergency exits, and so on.

products.name: SANIBORD ALU
products.description: Sanibord is a range of technical aluminium, painted and PVC profiles, which are perfect for joining ceramic coverings to bathroom fittings, or coverings and work surfaces. Not only do they get rid of any need for silicone sealants, these products combine visual appeal and high standards of hygiene to perfection, thanks to the characteristic shape which is easy to clean. Sanibord is also available with a special anti-bacterial coating: this technology reduces the presence of the most dangerous bacteria by up to 99%.

products.name: SANIBORD PVC
products.description: Sanibord is a range of technical aluminium, painted and PVC profiles, which are perfect for joining ceramic coverings to bathroom fittings, or coverings and work surfaces. Not only do they get rid of any need for silicone sealants, these products combine visual appeal and high standards of hygiene to perfection, thanks to the characteristic shape which is easy to clean. Sanibord is also available with a special anti-bacterial coating: this technology reduces the presence of the most dangerous bacteria by up to 99%.

products.name: SLAB LIFTING HANDLE
products.description: Adjustable slab lifting device for moving and installing ceramic slabs.

products.name: SLIM DRAIN
products.description: Slim Drain is a range of easy-to-fit floor-level linear  drainage channels for showers, giving you the freedom to personalize the floor and wall coverings used in the shower. It is particularly suited for renovation projects, requiring a floor depth of only 65mm. Available with different grates, Slim Drain  linear drainage channels have an adjustable frame (7mm to 12.5mm deep, 48mm wide) and adjustable legs for easier levelling. Moreover, they have an integrated waterproofing membrane to reduce the risk of seepage and drain manufactured to EN 1253-1 (minimum flow rate 24 l/min).

products.name: SMART DRAIN
products.description: How about a modern bathroom that's stylish as well as practical and functional? With Smart Drain, an innovative range of drainage channels for floor level showers, this is possible. These products are quick and easy to install, requiring a concrete screed depth of 75mm, and are ideal for use with large size tiles. The Smart Drain range comes in five different stainless steel versions. The linear drainage channels are 77mm wide, and the length varies from 70 to 120cm.  Moreover, they have adjustable feet for easy levelling, an integrated waterproofing membrane to reduce the risk of seepage and the drain is manufactured to EN 1253-1 (minimum flow rate 24 l/min).

products.name: TERMINAL RC
products.description: RC is a range of end trims for floating wood and laminate floors, designed to allow the necessary expansion. These profiles can be selected in the anodised aluminium version or in natural aluminium coated with Alcrom ® Plus film, to meet any aesthetic requirement. The RC range is also available in the Flex version, to assure the profile matches or can be adapted to specific curvatures of floors which are not straight.

products.name: TERMINAL RC FLEX
products.description: Among the Profilpas solutions for the application of end trims on non-linear surfaces is Terminal Flex RCF/. Made of silver anodised aluminium, it is the bendable version of RC, a range of end trims suitable for floating wood and laminate floors.

products.name: THIN DRAIN
products.description: Getting rid of the traditional shower tray and turning the shower into a continuation of the rest of the bathroom is a striking and also functional decision. Thanks to Thin Drain drainage channels, floor-level showers can also be added during renovation projects. The linear drains  are versatile and easy to install, a key benefit being the reduced depth of substrate required, only 55mm. Thin Drain channels come with different grates, either high-shine or brushed stainless steel, and are suitable for tile thicknesses of up to 12mm. Moreover, they have a shaped base for installation, an integrated waterproofing membrane to reduce the risk of seepage and the drain is manufactured to EN 1253-1 (minimum flow rate 24 l/min).

products.name: TILE SPACER
products.description: Tile Spacers and Wedges is a range of plastic spacers and wedges used when installing ceramic and stone tiles of various sizes and thicknesses, suitable for both floors and walls. They have been developed to assist the installer in positioning the tiles and to ensure uniform and precise grout lines. Cross spacers and “T” spacers are available for joint widths ranging from 1 mm to 10 mm. Wedges are used to compensate for small differences in height during tile installation. The range is completed by cross-shaped spacers for outdoor use for the dry-lay installation of self-supporting slabs.

products.name: UNISYSTEM PLUS C/
products.description: Items in the Unisystem Plus C/ range are threshold profiles for floors of different heights which also allow for the expansion of floating wood or laminate floors with thicknesses from 6.5mm to 22.6mm. Unisystem Plus C/ profiles are available with Alcrom® Plus wood patterns and can be further personalized using PDS (Profilpas Digital System) technology, which allows you to create a profile in the same colour as the floor to assure a perfect, matching effect.

products.name: UNISYSTEM PLUS G/2 - PLUS G/4
products.description: Unisystem Plus G/2 and G/4 are stair nosings which allow for the expansion of floating wood or laminate floors, of thicknesses from 6.5mm to 15mm. Unisystem Plus G/2 and G/4 come in anodised aluminium and with Alcrom® Plus wood patterns and the possibility of further customisation with PDS technology .

products.name: UNISYSTEM PLUS S/9-S/15
products.description: With its Unisystem Plus S/9 and Unisystem Plus S/15 edging profiles, Profilpas has created solutions which allow for the expansion of floating wood or laminate floors in thicknesses from 6.5mm to 22.6mm (inclusive).  For optimal results, the base must be selected in line with the thickness of the floor. Unisystem Plus S/9 and Unisystem Plus S/15 are available with Alcrom® Plus finishes, and using PDS® technology , they can also be further personalized with a decoration of  your choice.

products.name: UNISYSTEM PLUS Z/
products.description: Unisystem Plus Z/ threshold profiles were designed to join floors of equal heights, in either wood or laminate. These joints allow for the expansion of floating floors with thicknesses from 6.5mm to 22.6mm. The entire system comprises an aluminium base, clips, top profile, available in anodised aluminium or with Alcrom® Plus decor. These profiles can also be further personalized using PDS (Profilpas Digital System) technology, which allows you to create a profile in the same colour as the floor to assure a perfect, matching effect.
